requirements.title: Explicit write targets
requirements.statement: Every write-capable governance_amendment or stage_operation authorization requires at least one explicit repository path; an empty write target set is REJECT.

requirements.title: Trusted diff base
requirements.statement: The candidate cannot choose the authoritative diff base. The trusted verifier derives the base from the protected main lineage or an externally supplied PR base SHA.

requirements.title: Non-self-authorizing scope
requirements.statement: ACTION_SCOPE may restrict but cannot expand the root maximum and cannot remove mandatory forbidden patterns.

requirements.title: Scope sealing
requirements.statement: Once a stage is in_progress, its ACTION_SCOPE is byte-sealed to the introduction commit and later mutation is REJECT.

requirements.title: Live GitHub provenance
requirements.statement: Accepted governance evidence must be cross-checked against the official GitHub API for repository, run id, workflow path, exact head SHA, terminal status and success conclusion.

requirements.title: Acceptance chain
requirements.statement: Governance acceptance history is represented by an append-only SHA-256 hash chain containing qualifying source/run, accepted-state source/run, PR, merge commit and post-merge run.

requirements.title: Derived stage advance and release
requirements.statement: advance_stage and release require dependency/closure evidence and exact acceptance bindings; release cannot be authorized by a manually editable boolean alone.

requirements.title: Trusted verifier ratchet
requirements.statement: Future pull requests are evaluated by a pull_request_target workflow and verifier sourced from the protected base branch, never by the candidate copy of the judge; root-critical verifier/workflow identities become steady-state immutable after bootstrap.

requirements.title: External main protection
requirements.statement: main must require pull requests, strict required checks pinned to the expected GitHub Actions app, enforcement for administrators, no routine PR bypass, and reject force pushes/deletion. Human approval requirements follow the explicitly declared maintainer model: in single-maintainer mode the required approval count is exactly 0 and fictitious self-review or an alternate account controlled by the same maintainer is forbidden.

requirements.title: Undefined future stage scopes block
requirements.statement: EV-01..EV-20 are fail-closed until a prior accepted governance amendment defines each stage maximum scope.

requirements.title: Permanent governance mutation tests
requirements.statement: SCN-REGRESSION-005 permanently tests empty write targets, scope expansion, forbidden removal, candidate diff-base selection, post-start scope mutation, root weakening, fabricated local provenance, incomplete release closure, non-strict status checks, wrong required-check app binding, PR bypass allowances, and a nonzero human-approval requirement in declared single-maintainer mode.

requirements.title: Release attestation boundary
requirements.statement: A release requires cryptographic provenance attestation. When GitHub private-repository attestations are unavailable on the repository plan, release remains blocked until an approved attestation capability is configured; local JSON is not a substitute.
